🔍 Sabiway API Documentation - Search

Endpoints for searching posts, profiles, and hashtags.

Search posts, profiles, or hashtags. The type query parameter is optional and defaults to posts if omitted.

Query parameters:

  • q (string) — search keyword (required)
  • type (string, optional) — search type: posts, profiles, hashtags. Defaults to posts.

Examples:

Search Posts (default)

GET /search/?q=Django

Response:
[
  {
    "id": "b16f3585-6229-4d5b-bdc2-769202586a86",
    "content": "Learning Django is fun! #django #python",
    "author": {
      "user_id": 1,
      "username": "@johndoe",
      "full_name": "John Doe",
      "profile_picture": null
    },
    "created_at": "2025-10-01T16:00:00Z",
    "likes_count": 5,
    "comments_count": 2,
    "reposts_count": 1
  }
]

Search Profiles

GET /search/?q=John&type=profiles

Response:
[
  {
    "user_id": 1,
    "username": "@johndoe",
    "full_name": "John Doe",
    "profile_picture": null
  },
  {
    "user_id": 2,
    "username": "@johnsmith",
    "full_name": "John Smith",
    "profile_picture": "https://res.cloudinary.com/demo/image/upload/v123456/johnsmith.jpg"
  }
]

Search Hashtags

GET /search/?q=django&type=hashtags

Response:
[
  {
    "id": 1,
    "tag": "django",
    "use_count": 120
  },
  {
    "id": 2,
    "tag": "django_rest_framework",
    "use_count": 45
  }
]
